expenditures.detail: Form B does not exist in this document (single-page PDF, cover only). Cover line 3 prints 8523.67 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. Escalated both cells to a 1200 dpi tight crop because the third glyph is the bistable open-top shape that produced the Rhodes reversal in this county: at ~630-1090 dpi effective both cells are unambiguously 8523.67, the glyph is a flat-based 2 (NOT a 4). The decimal separator is written as a comma-like blob sitting on the rule; the form is otherwise US decimal-point and there is no thousands separator, so it is the decimal point and the value is $8,523.67.
